== Possibly faulty data ==
* The previous stub said the type was introduced in [[Official Tournament Sealed Deck]] (May 1998). OTSD is a sealed product with no Defensive Shield card type. [[Reflections III]] (31 October 2001) printed the type, the Starting Effects, and the Rules Supplement. Corrected 16 October 2026.
